# ECharts 5.4.3

Vendored copy of the Apache ECharts browser bundle used by the Web analysis page.
It replaces the previous CDN reference so the application can run without any
third-party script origin.

- Upstream: https://github.com/apache/echarts
- Package: `echarts@5.4.3` from the npm registry
- File: `dist/echarts.min.js` from the published package
- SHA-256: `1156429a16a38cb8604dcc6518c19406d4226142d908f8edd2e3531443c54d19`
- License: Apache License 2.0 (see `LICENSE` in this directory)

Do not edit the minified bundle. To upgrade, download the exact npm package
version, replace both files, update the version and SHA-256 here, and update
`THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.
